checks: A vague spoken update displays actual cost fields and asks its rendered field question without changing source data
A manual field selection immediately cancels a pending spoken choice and its delayed guide cannot overwrite or narrate the new selection
A short spoken field choice retains the exact population and advances only to the amount question
The spoken amount preserves its selected field and requires an explicit employee-cost allocation
The explicit allocation choice advances to rationale without inventing a reason or applying a change
The spoken rationale produces exact review rows; proposal review supersedes the earlier guide and remains unapplied
An incomplete spoken Apply prompts locally for exact confirmation, preserving the proposal without a write or analytical request
Explicit spoken Apply persists employee loaded cost with the exact user rationale and recalculates the dashboard
Spoken undo restores the original source values through the actual persistence endpoint
storage: Isolated temporary directory; existing .state and .env untouched
transport: Simulated speech and Live protocol; real source guide, renderer and HTTP persistence
